title: main-ref's hook installer works with any core.hooksPath and says it needs bash
why: c138's installer reviewer (Oct 28) proved two faults in githooks/main-ref/install.sh on main: with a relative or ~ core.hooksPath it installs where git does not look, so the main-ref guard is off in other worktrees; and its usage says sh, but it uses pipefail, so it needs bash.
note: Debt. Next cloud lane: githooks/main-ref/install.sh resolves core.hooksPath as git does (relative to the worktree root, ~ expanded) and its usage line says bash (or it drops pipefail); red first on a clone with a relative hooksPath whose sibling worktree runs no guard. Touches only githooks/main-ref/ and its test. Needs no answer. Port: no; the guard installs from claude-settings. Placed ahead of c107 (triage, Oct 28): a guard that is silently off in other worktrees.
